title: Marian F Probable NDE 4238
content: I was lying in the dentist chair. I could hear the Christmas music playing and it sounded like it was stuck on one note. I could feel the dentist's hand in my mouth and I was so anxious. He asked if I was okay. I think I shrugged and then nodded. I think he turned up the gas because then I felt relaxed. I quit hearing music at all and I couldn't open my eyes. I started thinking about the kids in my life. Elijah is my fifteen-year-old son with special needs, my classroom of children and their holiday, and my principal and her children. I just kept relaxing deeper and I thought, 'I can't remember my mother's face anymore.' I tried and I couldn't and I wondered when that happened. I noticed a very dark corner on the upper left-hand side of my 'view'. In the center of it was a vivid white light, really not more than a pupil-sized light. It was so brilliant and whiter than any white I'd ever noticed. I knew what it was so I didn't want to look. But I did look because it was beautiful and pure white and lovely. I could feel my body in the chair and I started to recite the people that anchored me to my life: Mackenzie, Elijah, kids and principal at school, my sons, my partner, my parents, my friends. But, that light was calling me and I was moving toward it. I felt me moving out of the chair at the same time I felt my body in the chair. I was in two places. I knew 'it' was happening and I thought, 'Elijah'. I moved back into the chair but then the light was still there and I saw it and I wondered about my mother's face and I saw the light move closer to me and it wasn't a pinpoint anymore. It was big and squarer. It was coming to me and it was okay. I had this sudden thought 'He'll be okay.' Some sense of him being cared for and I could just let go. I thought, 'I go alone.' and I relaxed. I felt myself move forward and meld into light. My shoulders moved back. I had a last second of choice and I thought NO. I pulled back away, turned completely away, the dentist hit my hand, called my name, and said we would have to stop. He said he was turning off the gas and up the oxygen because I was passing out.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt relaxed; reported being 'in two places' (moving out of the chair while also feeling body in the chair).

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Dental procedure with nitrous oxide ('gas'); dentist said she was passing out and switched off gas and increased oxygen.

person_demographics.occupation: Teacher (mentions 'my classroom of children' and 'my principal').

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Reported being in two places (moving out of chair while also feeling body in chair); dark corner with vivid white light; 'meld into light'; last-second choice to pull back; dentist intervened and stopped procedure.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Relaxation/passing out during dental gas, perception of dark corner and brilliant light, partial separation/being in two places, movement toward light and beginning to merge, then active refusal and return to body with dentist stopping procedure.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Felt herself moving out of the chair while simultaneously feeling her body in the chair ('I was in two places').

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Occurred during dental procedure under gas; music distortion ('stuck on one note' then stopped). Light appeared as a pupil-sized pinpoint in a dark corner, later becoming 'big and squarer' and seeming to come toward her.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I felt me moving out of the chair at the same time I felt my body in the chair. I was in two places.” “I felt myself move forward and meld into light.” “I had a last second of choice and I thought NO.”
